summary: Mobile-first private family chat app “saddamchait” with React UI and a structured ICP (Motoko) backend + React frontend template; Firebase (Spark/free) Email/Password authentication remains integrated into the existing auth screens with Firestore-backed approval-gated access (pending approval; first user bootstraps as Super Admin) and the Forgot Password flow disabled in favor of admin-managed resets, while the ICP backend now also includes explicit Motoko authorization/access-control and user-approval modules integrated into the main canister.

existing_features.title: Motoko backend canister scaffold
existing_features.description: Base Motoko canister source and system IDL wiring suitable for ICP deployment, with generated frontend declarations for actor typing.

existing_features.title: React + Vite + Tailwind frontend scaffold
existing_features.description: React application setup (Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind) with app shell, routing/screens entrypoints, and project config files.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication integration
existing_features.description: Hooks and UI layout/screens for authentication using Internet Identity, including actor initialization support.

existing_features.title: Reusable UI component library (shadcn/ui) included
existing_features.description: Vendored shadcn/ui component set and supporting utilities/config (eslint rules, components.json, utils).

existing_features.title: Build/deploy template and automation scripts
existing_features.description: Build template assets (Dockerfile, deploy.sh, canister yaml templates, workspace/package configs) plus scripts for pruning/resizing images and build orchestration.

existing_features.title: Auth UI screens (login, signup, password reset)
existing_features.description: Frontend screens and layout for user authentication flows, including Login, Signup, and Password Reset screens integrated with existing Internet Identity hooks.

existing_features.title: Camera capture hook and profile image processing utilities
existing_features.description: Client-side camera capture hook plus utilities for processing profile images (e.g., resizing/format handling) to support avatar/profile photo workflows.

existing_features.title: ICP CLI / GitHub export-ready project template configuration
existing_features.description: Provides standardized icp-cli compatible project templates and configs (icp.yaml, per-canister canister.yaml templates, build/deploy scripts and workspace packaging) to support reproducible builds and repository export workflows.

existing_features.title: Firebase Web SDK Email/Password auth integrated into existing auth screens
existing_features.description: Adds Firebase initialization and wires existing Login/Signup screens to Firebase Email/Password authentication without introducing new screens or changing the overall UI structure.

existing_features.title: Approval-gated access model backed by Firestore user records
existing_features.description: On signup, persists an application-level user record (e.g., status/role) with status="pending approval" and blocks access/login until approved, showing exactly "Account pending approval" for unapproved users.

existing_features.title: First-user bootstrap to Super Admin role
existing_features.description: Automatically assigns the first successfully registered user the "Super Admin" role (persisted in the same user record used for approval gating) and supports both PREVIEW and LIVE environments.

existing_features.title: Forgot Password flow disabled; admin-managed password resets only
existing_features.description: Updates the existing Password Reset flow to remove/disable Firebase email reset behavior and replaces confirmation copy to state that password resets are handled manually by an Admin only (no new screens).

existing_features.title: Motoko authorization/access-control and user-approval modules integrated into backend canister
existing_features.description: Adds Motoko-side authorization primitives (access-control + authorization mixin) and user-approval logic modules, wired into the backend main canister to support role/approval-based gating at the canister layer.

existing_features.title: Developer-facing clarification note on auth constraints (Internet Identity vs Firebase Auth)
existing_features.description: Adds a developer-facing comment/README/spec note clarifying the platform constraint that only Internet Identity is supported for third-party authentication and explicitly requesting confirmation on whether Firebase Auth remains required despite this limitation, without restructuring the app or adding screens.

existing_features.title: Update the Firebase login approval check so that every login attempt performs a fresh Firestore server read for the authenticated user profile at the exact document path `users/{auth.uid}` (where `auth.uid` is Firebase Auth `currentUser.uid` / `user.uid`), and uses that document’s `approved` boolean field as the sole source of truth for approval gating.
Remove/disable any email-based profile lookup and any cached approval logic in the login flow; ensure there are no Firestore queries by email and no reuse of prior approval state between logins.

Update the LIVE smoke test/deployment verification guidance to explicitly validate the new login behavior (fresh server read every login, `users/{auth.uid}` only, no email lookup, no cached approval state) and reference the expected console/log indicators for troubleshooting.

architectural_notes: Project structured as ICP canisters with separate backend (Motoko) and frontend (React) configurations and generated declaration files for typed actor calls.
Frontend auth uses Internet Identity; custom linting/rules enforce correct II provider usage and avoid problematic query-key bigint usage.
shadcn/ui components are vendored into the repository with shared UI utilities and Tailwind/PostCSS configuration.
Build/deploy is standardized via a build-template (Dockerfile, deploy script, canister yaml templates) and supporting Node scripts (image prune/resize).
Frontend includes a camera capture hook and a dedicated profile image processing utility module for handling user-provided images (e.g., avatars).
Build template now includes icp-cli/GitHub-export oriented configuration (icp.yaml plus per-canister canister.yaml templates) aligned with deploy.sh and workspace packaging for reproducible exports.

App now targets Firebase backend (Spark/free) for auth + Firestore; integrate Firebase Email/Password and store per-user approval status/roles to gate login (pending approval until admin approves; first user becomes super admin).
Frontend now includes Firebase initialization/modules (firebase.ts, types, error mapping) and uses Firebase Email/Password auth for existing auth screens.
User approval/role gating is implemented via Firestore-backed application user records (status/role) that gate login and bootstrap first user as Super Admin.

Build template/core infrastructure and Motoko authorization/user-approval modules have been revised and versioned (core-infrastructure v1.0.2, authorization v4.0.0, user-approval v3.0.0), with corresponding updates across backend modules and build-template assets.
known_issues: LIVE login gating bug: app still shows "Your account is pending admin approval" even when Firestore doc exists at users/{auth.uid} with approved:true; must enforce fresh getDoc() on every login using users/{auth.uid} only (no email lookup, no cached approval state).
